reviews.text:
We have called Brad and his guys multiple times and always been very pleased. They are kind, professional, knowledgeable, fairly priced and communicative.

In the past we have called large companies and the experience with Brad and His crew is far superior.

Total Care plumbing has become our go to for plumbing. It can be hard to find reliable people in trades because there are so many to choose from in the metroplex. It gives us peace of mind to know they are there when we need them. 5 stars al

Wow!  Brad and his team have saved my sanity several times. They are always fixing either my mistakes (too much fibrous vegetable down the disposal) or clearing a toilet drain or replacing my crummy plumbing fixtures with good fixtures.

Fast, neat with perfect cleanup afterwards. Also easy to schedule. Now, if only I could find an equally great electrician, roofer and arborist to make my life worry free.

Brad and his guys were awesome. They diagnosed a faulty pipe connection to the sewer and fixed it. They were quick, accurate and professional. I’m calling them again if I need additional plumbing services.
Total Care Plumbing fixed two separate issues for me over the past two weeks. They were on time, professional, reasonably priced and did fantastic work. Highly recommend!

We had a major plumbing job of replacing all cast iron pipes with new PVC throughout the home.  I was very nervous about this process considering they had to tunnel under my house.  Brad was so professional and kept in constant constant contact with me throughout the whole process explaining every next step.  The clean up was impeccable.  It was a great experience.  I will never use another plumber.  Brad is honest, caring and will take great care of you.  His prices are better than most plumber

Originally had a different company come out- they tried one thing and told me the pipes were rotted & that we would need to replace the entire half of the piping system. I called Total Care for a second opinion- Brad came out, told us it wasn’t a collapsed pipe and fixed the clog in less than an hour! Super knowledgeable (he gave us at least 3 different options of how we could fix the piping had it been collapsed), nice, helpful & saved us thousands!! Will definitely be calling Total Care first

Total Care Plumbing is the best plumber I have ever used. They were quick to respond, extremely professional, and quickly assessed and took care of the problem. I would highly recommend them to everyone I know!

Brad was super professional, quick and priced well.  He fixed our hot water heater instead of automatically trying to sell us one like other companies I called. Everything you want in a plumber and more. The honesty alone is priceless.  His sons work on his team and were so kind and professional as well!  A true gem and family owned and operated.

Brad and his assistant were a pleasure to work with.  They listened to my issue, and offered a couple of solutions, explaining exactly what each solution would require, and the expected results.  I decided on which one (easiest) to try, and they had my issue resolved in less than 15 minutes.  They even offered me a free service call but were kind enough to allow me to buy them lunch.  It's unheard of in this day and age that a contractor isn't trying to take you for every dollar or sell you some
These guys are the best!! Great work, Great attitudes, quick and efficient! I would recommend them to anyone! Recommendations from the team feel helpful, not a scolding! Did a wonderful job!!
Called this morning for a clogged drain.  They were out in less than 3 hours.  Clean, courteous, fixed the clogged drain and fixed our toilet as well.  Highly recommend and will use them again.

Outstanding service!
My 84 year old mother had a water leak underneath her house. I scheduled an appointment with Total Care to come out and do the repairs. They arrived on time, assessed the damage and gave me an estimate. Gave it a day to let the lake beneath the house dry out a little. Mark and his assistant (a polite young man whose name I forgot - sorry!) did a fantastic job, laid down mats to protect the floor, wore shoe covers every time they came in and out, and completed the repair quic

Total Care Plumbing is hands down the best plumbing service we’ve ever used! They went above and beyond for my elderly mother, treating her with so much kindness and respect. From the moment we called, they listened carefully to our concerns and made sure we fully understood the situation without any pressure or unnecessary upsells.

Unlike other companies that try to nickel and dime you, these guys were incredibly fair with their pricing: no hidden fees, no surprises, just honest, quality work.

I can honestly say that if you have a plumbing issues to give this company a call. They were able to get to us very quickly. I had another plumber out here fixing this two months ago and did not fix the issue. They were able to come in and detect the problem and fix it at a very reasonable rate .
Perfect experienced plumbers, fast work and know what they are doing. Highly recommend

Looking for a plumber in  Colleyville, Southlake area, this  is best plumber around hands down. I called Brad with Total Care Plumbing he came out after hours and fixed my leaking water heater in a jiffy. So happy to have hot water again!! Will use Total Care Plumbing again and totally recommend Total Care Plumbing. Thanks guys for your help!!

Look no further, this is your plumber you’ve been looking for! Brad has been out to our home a couple of times. He is responsive, timely, professional & gets the job done efficiently, and at very fair pricing! We know because we’ve shopped around ! Brad, thank you for your excellent service, we look forward to the next large project we discussed! From your very happy customers, Melissa and Manuel Prieto

Brad was Extremely Professional and Very Transparent about prices, I had a Slab leak going to my Master Bathroom and he ran a new line without having to cut hardly any wall in a couple hours. I was able to go back to work by lunch time. Didn't cost me an arm and a leg either! 5/5 i would recommend them to anyone! Very Knowledgeable.
Brad has quickly come and helped us out more than once and done a great job each time for a reasonable price.

I have used many plumbers over the years but Brad has been the best plumber I have seen yet. He is prompt, timely and very good. Pricing is excellent and service is superior. Most definitely recommend.

Brad and his apprentice are the best! We originally called them on a recommendation from a neighbor, and I’m so glad we did. He is a straight shooter, very fair on price, and helps explain problems and options. We have had Brad fix many plumbing issues in our home, including descaling cast iron pipes, installing a two-way clean out, and installing a new garage sink with a tricky drain situation. Always prompt and professional and clean! We will use Total Care Plumbing for any future plumbing nee

Great service! Did an excellent job installing our water heater 3 years ago.  Did the work to raise the floor because the old one was sitting in a bit of a tub.  Recently when our roof was redone, the roofers messed up the ventilation on the tank and total care came out and fixed it for free!

Total Care was the second plumbing company I called, and so glad I did!  The first company I called quoted me $1100 for a garbage disposal replacement (company provided), and two bidet toilet seats that I provided. Brad's quoted price was $620 on the high side. Actual cost after completion was $540 total.He and his mentor were timely, professional, courteous and efficient!
Highly recommend Total Care Plumbing!

Update Review 12.4.24...
I just want to say after hitting an issue that was totally out of the control of both Total Care Plumbing and me. Brad and his company went above and beyond to resolve the issue! It was a frustrating and perplexing issue that occurred, but TCP really stepped in to accomplish a full-on resolution. THANK YOU for your assistance with the intent to get this squared away. The integrity and customer service with Total Care Plumbing is real, HIRE THESE GUYS!

Hands down best Pl

Brad from Total Care Plumbing was absolutely amazing. Not only did he show up on a holiday, but he got water restored to my house very quickly and for an emergency plumber. He was very reasonably priced great company will recommend to all of my friends. I promise if you have a plumbing problem, total care will take care of you.

Want a great plumber?
Brad and his helper Christian are professional and courteous.
We have used Total Care Plumbing for over 5 years for a variety of plumbing needs.
They are top notch!
I trust Brad’s work and his fairness when it comes to price.
Look no further call Total Care Plumbing.

Water heater replacement. Brad arrived on time, put down tarps to cover the flooring and carpeting. He worked quickly and did a great job. He neatened up all the plumbing and venting. Good job. No mess left behind.

No fuss, quality work and very efficient. They had the right experience to resolve all of my hot water heater challenges. I highly recommend Brad, he’s a great business owner and knows how to get it done.

Today was our first experience with Brad.  We based our decision to call him largely on the excellent reviews we had read.  Well, it’s all true excellent service easy to talk to with no surprises.  We have an older home on an acre in Colleyville which when built was on a septic system.  All the homes in this area were converted to the sewer system sometime in the 70’s which has its own unique issues since all the original pipes went to the back yard and now go around the house to the street. Eve

Awesome sustained services for my family for years now. We think of Brad as a trusted friend! Fair pricing, guarantees, and efficient, quality work. Great response time as well! A shout out to Christian as well!

Total Care Plumbing has done excellent work at my house for more than 6 years. I have used them for major and minor repairs during that time, and  I have received the highest quality work at fair and honest prices. You won’t be disappointed if you call them. They will be courteous, come when they say they will and they will do a good job for you too.

Brad and his helper are simply AMAZING!!!
Not only they took care of my parents house plumbing needs that another plumbing company didn’t/couldn’t even acknowledge the problem! They were professional, and went over the options with us! He even went to the plumbing store to get the right cartridge for us , and didn’t charge extra for the extra trip that they took !!!
Brad sure will be on my contact list for our plumbing issues!
THE GREATEST

I came home to a leak and called Brad. He was here in 30 minutes and diagnosed the cause and got it taken care of!!  So glad to finally have found a quality plumber. I will use him again for all my plumbing needs.

Brad and Christin are amazing!  They have helped us multiple times.  Brad is very knowledgeable patient with questions. Pricing is always fair and straightforward.  Total Care Plumbing is our go to plumber!!!
Pipe broke and Brad arrived within 15 min and had the repair done in an hour. Great guys, honest and trustworthy. Can't thank y'all enough!

This is a great family owned and operated business! We’ve had them out a couple times chasing down a small leak in our system. They have been very upfront and honest about the process involved and took a lot of extra time to answer all of our questions. I appreciate their wealth of knowledge and experience. I will definitely be calling them in the future with any plumbing or gas issues.

We have used Total Care Plumbing a few times and have always had a good experience. I wanted to take the time to write this review now because we were on the verge of a plumbing nightmare but the day was saved by Total Care! Our toilets weren't flushing and tubs weren't draining, and because it happened on the weekend we called another company with weekend dispatch who ended up quoting us $13,000 for total pipe replacement because they said our pipes collapsed. As soon as we could we called Tota
Owner extremely unprofessional and these guys messed up all my pipes. Would not reccomend. They still charged full price too.

After a horrible experience from another well-advertised large local plumber, on another repair job, I Googled “plumbers near me” and Total Care Plumbing popped up showing nothing but solid 5-Star reviews, so I did not hesitate calling after reading the reviews.  Brad was able to quickly work me into his schedule, showed up on time, gave me a decent price for the repair and repaired the leaking water line, from what I could tell, better than the original work.  I’m happy to have found Brad with

Brad was great to work with.  I used their service specifically because I read all the reviews on his company!  When we called Total Care, we thought our problem was a hot water heater, but Brad quickly determined it wasn't the heater but a leak under the slab.  Brad was able to fix it quickly also!  I will never call another plumber.

Professional and reasonable. Brad did a great job installing our tankless heater. Other places wouldn't even come and give estimates to our situation because I wanted an electric installed. I will be using total care for all my future plumbing needs

We have used this company, Total Care Plumbing on three different occasions! They are a professional, prompt and reliable company to work with! Brad, the owner is a man of integrity! We appreciate the truth being told to us, especially when our plumbing issues are not as bad as we thought they would be! We would highly recommend Brad and his company, Total Care Plumbing for all of your plumbing needs!

We decided to have our entire house replumbed due to age and we wanted to change out any remaining galvanized pipe. Brad was great. He was upfront with costs and expectations. He kept us informed throughout the entire process. We are so happy with the work done and will gladly recommend this company. Great job!

Brad is AMAZING!!.  We had a foundation leak and Brad was able to locate it and repair it with out tearing up my tile and hardwood floors.  He is extremely professional and competent.  He even cleaned up when he was finished.  I will use Brad and Total Care Plumbing for all my plumbing needs in the future.  Thank you Brad, you are a life saver.

Brad showed up on time. Was very professional and extremely competent. He helped me to descale my water heater but also fixed a few things around the house. He answered all my questions and was reasonable in his fees. I finally found a fantastic plumber that I can keep on my speed dial.

Amazing Plumbers!!! I had a leak on my water heater and it turned out I also had a slab leak.
Total Care Plumbing took care of everything in one call and had great prices! I recommend if you have a clogged drain, slab leak, water heater problem, or a simple service call, you should call this company.
They were very up front and honest. They arrived on time, very friendly and efficient, removed the old water heater and installed the new one. I will be using their services again.

Brad went above and beyond what I expected! Highly recommend for an honest man and the best pricing compared to any other plumber. He is independent and works for himself! Our first encounter was for a leak my inspector noted but couldn’t find during a house inspection prior to me purchasing my house. I called Brad and he came out and found the problem in 30 minutes. It was leaking from the shower head and fixed it on the spot!  I have used Brad to replumb several pipes and water lines in my hou

Brad came out to repair a pipe in the garage of one of our properties.  He arrived on time and gave advance notice when he was on his way.

I originally thought the pipe had burst from the recent freeze.  However, upon inspection, a repair made to the pipe by another plumber during the 2021 freeze failed.  Brad repaired the pipe the proper way.  He was very professional, excellent communication (particularly as I was not onsite), and cost was reasonable and disclosed prior to making the repair.

I highly recommend Total Care Plumbing! They are very professional and confident in the service they provide. Brad removed my old sink, installed my new kitchen sink and installed my new garbage disposal.  I am thrilled with the completed work!!! They did an excellent job and I'm very happy.  They are my only "Go To" now for any plumbing issues or needs. Thank you Total Care Plumbing!
